_doc: Enemies for Combat.resolve. realm/stage give a baseline from realm power (see combat.gd); hp/attack/defense/speed are added on top. lethal: losing kills the player; otherwise the player is beaten, loses defeat_stone_loss of their spirit stones and may be injured (combat_defeat in injuries.json). spar (optional bool): a refereed bout that never kills or robs (a defeat can still injure), e.g. a tournament. tags (optional): e.g. "cultivator" marks a human cultivator whose cultivation can be devoured (data/demonic_arts.json). rewards use the shared Effects keys (set_flag there unlocks a follow-up encounter only once the enemy is beaten). techniques: technique ids the enemy knows at enemy_technique_level. realm_training (QA-007d): one {attack, defense, max_hp, speed} entry per realm index (the last covers higher realms; flat from Void Refinement up, CMB-010), added to every enemy of that realm like technique bonuses (scaled by realm power), standing in for the techniques and gear a same-realm player has. power_mult (optional float, 0.5-1.5, default 1.0, CMB-011): multiplies the enemy's scaled max_hp, attack and defense after realm power and realm_training, before the flat hp/attack/defense. form_spread: each side's attack is multiplied by a random form in [1 - form_spread, 1 + form_spread] per fight, so a typical player beats a plain enemy of their own realm and stage ~75-90% of the time instead of always.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.description: A bad-tempered boar rooting through the fields.

enemies.name: Mountain Bandit
enemies.description: A mortal thug with a rusty saber.

enemies.name: Mist Wolf
enemies.description: A grey wolf that has swallowed enough qi to vanish into fog.

enemies.name: Den Wolf
enemies.description: A grey wolf driven from its den by the hunters' dogs, more desperate than deadly.

enemies.name: Rogue Cultivator
enemies.description: A desperate cultivator who kills for resources.

enemies.name: Vengeful Brother
enemies.description: The elder brother of the traveller you robbed, a sect disciple with red eyes and a blade he has sharpened for months.

enemies.name: Vengeful Sect Elder
enemies.description: A grey-robed Foundation Establishment elder who has come to collect a debt of blood for two of his disciples.

enemies.name: Azure Cloud Sword Examiner
enemies.description: An Inner Disciple of the Azure Cloud Sect who tests every candidate's swordwork with a wooden sword that cuts like steel.

enemies.name: Sword Pavilion Warden
enemies.description: The warden of the Azure Cloud Sword Pavilion. Only those who can force him back three steps may call themselves Core Disciples.

enemies.name: Grand Elder's Sword Shadow
enemies.description: A sword shadow the Grand Elder leaves in the trial hall, holding a fraction of his Core Formation sword intent.

enemies.name: Blood Pit Gladiator
enemies.description: A scarred Blood Disciple who has won forty duels in the blood pit. Servants who want his rank must take it from him.

enemies.name: Blood Pit Champion
enemies.description: The reigning champion of the blood pit, soaked to the elbows. Blood Sons are made by beating him in front of the whole sect.

enemies.name: Vault Blood Warden
enemies.description: A blood-oathed warden of the Blood Merchant King, bound to guard the inner vault and to bleed anyone who tries to rob it.

enemies.name: Blood Ancestor's Puppet
enemies.description: A puppet stitched from a Blood Elder of old, animated by the sect ancestor to test those who would join the elders.

enemies.name: Pavilion Vault Guard
enemies.description: A steward who guards the Pavilion's appraisal vault. Candidates must get past him to appraise the treasure inside.

enemies.name: Pavilion Treasure Guardian
enemies.description: A bronze guardian armed with the Pavilion's lesser treasures. Senior stewards must prove they can protect what they sell.

enemies.name: Golden Abacus Guardian
enemies.description: An elder of the Pavilion who fights with a golden abacus whose beads strike like hail. Whoever outlasts him earns a seat among the elders.

enemies.name: Thunder Patriarch's Puppet
enemies.description: A puppet of black jade and lightning-scarred bronze, left to guard the patriarch's seat. It strikes to disable, never to kill.

enemies.name: Blood Lotus Raider
enemies.description: A Blood Lotus disciple raiding across the sect border, driven off rather than killed.

enemies.name: Azure Cloud Raider
enemies.description: An Azure Cloud disciple pressing across the sect border, driven off rather than killed.

enemies.name: Blood-Path Raider
enemies.description: A demonic raider leading the assault on the village. Realm and stage scale to the defender.

enemies.name: Tournament Contender
enemies.description: A cocky young disciple fighting for fame in the tournament ring. The referees stop the bout before anyone dies.

enemies.name: Tournament Champion
enemies.description: Last tournament's champion, a Foundation Establishment prodigy defending the title in front of every sect.

enemies.name: Mist Fox
enemies.description: A silver fox that slips in and out of the forest fog, biting at ankles.

enemies.name: Iron-Back Boar
enemies.description: A boar whose bristles have hardened into iron spikes from eating spirit-ore roots.

enemies.name: Wandering Boxer
enemies.description: A lean road-worn fighter who tests his fists on every traveller he meets. A friendly bout: he shakes your hand whichever way it ends.

enemies.name: Drunk Bully Disciple
enemies.description: A washed-out outer disciple who drinks away his stipend and shakes down the village stalls, swinging wildly with a borrowed sword.

enemies.name: Azure Crane
enemies.description: A sky-blue crane that strikes with a beak like a spear and is gone before you can answer.

enemies.name: Blood-Eyed Wolf
enemies.description: A marsh wolf grown fat on corpse qi. Its eyes glow red, and the Blood Lotus Sect prizes it as a hound.

enemies.name: Bandit Lord
enemies.description: A failed outer disciple who rules a bandit camp with a few scraps of qi and a heavy saber.

enemies.name: Stone Ape
enemies.description: A hulking ape whose hide has hardened into granite.

enemies.name: Hermit's Guest
enemies.description: A stubborn old guest of the grotto hut who tests every visitor with a fireplace poker.

enemies.name: Well Bandit
enemies.description: A bandit who followed the headman's grandson down the village rope, holding a rusted saber and a lantern.

enemies.name: Garden Poacher
enemies.description: A scavenging cultivator stripping the old library of slips and herbs, who yields once beaten.

enemies.name: Moss-Back Ape
enemies.description: A young ape that grew up in the Verdant Remnant, its fur thick with moss and its fists still soft.

enemies.name: Sword Mound Shade
enemies.description: The lingering sword-habit of a dead wandering swordsman, which rises from the mound to cross blades with anyone who comes to take his art. It tests you and never kills.

enemies.name: Grave Guardian Ape
enemies.description: The Fist Saint's old companion, grown gentle with age. It tests your fists but never your life.

enemies.name: Reed Hermit's Shade
enemies.description: The patient habit of a drowned hermit, which rises from the reeds with a fishing pole and tests anyone who comes for his lesson. It never kills.

enemies.name: Stone-Hide Boar King
enemies.description: A boar the size of an ox whose hide has hardened to grey stone. It rules a stretch of the Misty Forest and does not share it.

enemies.name: Drowned Venom Husk
enemies.description: A drowned cultivator hauled out of the mud and stitched into obedience, its fingers still dripping green poison.

enemies.name: Corpse Puppet Trio
enemies.description: Three half-finished corpse puppets, strung together with grave-iron wire and still twitching to their maker's last command.

enemies.name: Roadside Rogue Cultivator
enemies.description: A Foundation Establishment drifter with threadbare robes and a hungry eye, who would rather rob you than kill you.

enemies.name: Cloud Eagle
enemies.description: A spirit eagle that strikes from above the clouds.

enemies.name: Cave Guardian
enemies.description: An ancient puppet left to guard a fallen cultivator's cave.

enemies.name: Demonic Cultivator
enemies.description: A blood-path cultivator, reeking of slaughter.

enemies.name: Jade-Scaled Python
enemies.description: An ancient serpent coiled around a spirit herb.

enemies.name: Flame-Tailed Fox
enemies.description: A sly spirit fox whose three tails trail sparks. It guards the flame lotuses it feeds on.

enemies.name: Iron-Horned Rhino
enemies.description: A mountain rhino that grinds ore with its teeth until its horn turns to profound iron.

enemies.name: Ice-Soul Spider
enemies.description: A pale spider that spins frost-silk webs in the deep mist and drains the warmth from its prey.

enemies.name: Wandering Sword Madman
enemies.description: A rogue swordsman whose sword heart cracked. He challenges everyone he meets and spares no one.

enemies.name: Azure Cloud Enforcer
enemies.description: A zealous righteous disciple who sees demonic cultivators everywhere. He means to subdue you, not kill you.

enemies.name: Blood Lotus Executioner
enemies.description: A Blood Lotus disciple sent to collect fresh essence for the sect's blood pools.

enemies.name: Bronze Corpse Puppet
enemies.description: A corpse refined in bronze by some long-dead puppeteer. It feels no pain and never tires.

enemies.name: Thunderwing Roc
enemies.description: A great roc that rides storm clouds. Lightning crackles along its feathers as it dives.

enemies.name: Myriad Poison Toad
enemies.description: A toad the size of a house, grown fat on spirit herbs and venom. Its spit melts flying swords.

enemies.name: Black Iron Bear King
enemies.description: The lord of the ridge. Its fur is as hard as black iron and its roar shakes stones loose.

enemies.name: Blood Lotus Elder
enemies.description: A Core Formation elder of the Blood Lotus Sect, wrapped in a red mist of a thousand victims.

enemies.name: Starfall Vault Warden
enemies.description: A blood-robed warden left to guard the treasury since the star fell, half-mad from the long watch and weaker than the elders he once served.

enemies.name: Nether Ghost King
enemies.description: A ghost king born from a battlefield's resentment, ruling a court of wailing shades deep underground.

enemies.name: Marsh Corpse Puppet
enemies.description: A drowned soldier stitched shut with black thread and driven by a corpse-refiner's command. It shambles on though its limbs have rotted to the bone.

enemies.name: Drowned Yin Ghost
enemies.description: The wailing shade of a cultivator drowned in the sect war, grown strong on the marsh's yin qi. Its touch freezes the meridians.

enemies.name: Blood Lotus Scout
enemies.description: A lean Blood Lotus disciple sent to map the marsh's blood pools and cut down anyone who sees too much.

enemies.name: Cloud-Devouring Condor
enemies.description: A condor with a wingspan wider than a village, nesting above the cloud sea and swallowing storm clouds whole.

enemies.name: Magma-Scale Basilisk
enemies.description: A basilisk that sleeps in volcanic vents. Its scales glow like cooling slag and its gaze cracks stone.

enemies.name: Ancient Tortoise Sage
enemies.description: A ten-thousand-year tortoise whose shell is carved with unread stars. Little can break it, but it hits like a falling mountain.

enemies.name: Azure Law Enforcer
enemies.description: A Nascent Soul elder of the righteous sects who hunts demonic cultivators across the land. He means to subdue you, not kill you.

enemies.name: Hermit Sword Sage
enemies.description: A wandering sword cultivator who has outlived his sect and his friends. He tests every traveller on the road with a single, lethal question.

enemies.name: Blood Sea Deacon
enemies.description: A Nascent Soul deacon of the Blood Lotus Sect, trailing a crimson tide that drowns everything in its path.

enemies.name: Soul-Reaping Old Monster
enemies.description: An ancient demonic cultivator who has kept his Nascent Soul alive for three lifetimes by reaping others'. His soul fire is the colour of old bone.

enemies.name: Ancient Puppet Guardian
enemies.description: A guardian puppet of jade and star silver, left to defend a dead master's vault. It has been awake for ten thousand years.

enemies.name: Outer Disciple Bully
enemies.description: A swaggering Azure Cloud outer disciple who shakes down juniors for tribute. A bout, not a blood feud: he yields as soon as he is beaten.

enemies.name: Void-Rift Dragonling
enemies.description: A young true dragon born in a crack between peaks, scales rimed with void frost. Even a dragonling makes the air scream.

enemies.name: Heavenly Mandate Elder
enemies.description: A Soul Formation elder of the righteous alliance, sent to bring the wicked to judgment. He wants you kneeling, not dead.

enemies.name: Blood Moon Sovereign
enemies.description: A demonic sovereign who bathes in the blood of whole cities beneath a red moon only he can see.

enemies.name: Ten-Thousand-Peaks Roc
enemies.description: A storm roc that nests above the highest summit; its wings throw lightning across the ridge.

enemies.name: Ghost Banner Lord
enemies.description: An old demonic monster who rules a banner of ten thousand bound souls. They scream when he smiles.

enemies.name: Star-Devouring Colossus
enemies.description: A construct of star silver and dragonblood gold, built to guard a dead sect's last treasury against the sky itself.

enemies.name: Rent-Sky Wyrm
enemies.description: A wyrm that swims the tears in the sky, trailing torn space like a wake. Where it passes, the air does not close again.

enemies.name: Void Tribunal Censor
enemies.description: A Void Refinement censor of the righteous alliance who folds the road shut behind his quarry. He wants a confession, not a corpse.

enemies.name: Folded-World Ancestor
enemies.description: A demonic ancestor who keeps a whole village folded inside his sleeve and feeds on it, one breath at a time.

enemies.name: Starfall Thunder Roc
enemies.description: A roc that hunts between worlds, its cry shaking fallen stars loose from the dark above the peaks.

enemies.name: Hollow-Realm Lord
enemies.description: A demonic lord who hollowed out a pocket world and has ruled its empty halls for a thousand years. He is lonely, and he is hungry.

enemies.name: Heaven-Sundering Construct
enemies.description: A war construct of star silver and dragonblood gold, forged to hold a breach in the sky shut. It has not been told the war is over.

enemies.name: Flesh-World Behemoth
enemies.description: A beast whose body holds a whole valley, rivers and all. It walks slowly, because the world inside it is heavy.

enemies.name: One-Body Arbiter
enemies.description: A righteous arbiter who judges by whether a man is whole. He will break your guard, not your bones, and ask what you were hiding.

enemies.name: Marrow-Throne Ancestor
enemies.description: A demonic ancestor who sits on a throne of his own grown bone and has not risen from it in three hundred years. What he cannot reach, he eats through others.

enemies.name: Nine-Heavens Vermilion Roc
enemies.description: A roc with a heartbeat you can hear from the next mountain. Its wings beat in time with it, and the sky keeps that time too.

enemies.name: Bone-Court Sovereign
enemies.description: A demonic lord who made his own body a palace and his sins its courtiers. He greets you by name, and the name is not yours.

enemies.name: Dao-Forged Colossus
enemies.description: A guardian cast whole from star silver and one cultivator's vow. The vow outlived him, and it still guards the door he asked it to.

enemies.name: Sky-Bearing Tortoise
enemies.description: A tortoise whose shell carries a country, with cities and a sea of its own. It has walked beneath the heavens so long that it has forgotten it was ever small.

enemies.name: Great-Vehicle Magistrate
enemies.description: A righteous magistrate who judges whether a cultivator carries others or only himself. He will unmake your stance, not your life, and ask whom you left behind.

enemies.name: Myriad-Throne Ancestor
enemies.description: A demonic ancestor enthroned on a thousand thrones in a thousand pocket worlds, all of them his. He sits on every throne at once and rises from none.

enemies.name: Ten-Thousand-Li Peng
enemies.description: A peng whose shadow crosses provinces. It dives once a century, and the thunder it drags behind it has not finished arriving.

enemies.name: Charnel-Heaven Sovereign
enemies.description: A demonic sovereign who raised a heaven of his own out of the dead and crowned himself its sole god. The prayers still rise, though no one is left to pray.

enemies.name: Heaven-Gate Vow Guardian
enemies.description: A guardian cast from star silver and a vow sworn at the foot of the heavens. The gate it keeps has been open for an age, and it keeps it anyway.

enemies.name: Thunder-Vault Tortoise
enemies.description: A tortoise that has hauled the last lightning on its shell for ten thousand years. The storm sleeps in its plates, and it will wake the storm rather than be moved.

enemies.name: Ascent-Warden Arbiter
enemies.description: A righteous warden who stands on the last stair and weighs those who would climb it. He will break your stance, not your life, and tell you what the stair would have cost.

enemies.name: Hidden-Tribulation Elder
enemies.description: A demonic old monster who has dodged his own tribulation for three thousand years by hiding inside the lightning of others. He is very tired and very dangerous.

enemies.name: Nine-Thunder Peng
enemies.description: A peng that feeds on tribulation clouds. It circles the places where lightning gathers and eats whatever the sky leaves behind.

enemies.name: Lightning-Tithe Sovereign
enemies.description: A demonic sovereign who skims the lightning of every cultivator who fails the tribulation nearby, and has grown fat on the sum. He greets you as a future payment.

enemies.name: Final-Stair Vow Guardian
enemies.description: A guardian of star silver and a vow sworn on the last stair before the heavens. It does not bar the way up. It only asks whether you are finished below.
